newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money market rates stable, DTC has no impact.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money market rates stable, DTC has no impact.

text.p: Dutch money market rates were broadly stable on Monday afternoon, with call money only slightly down from the unually high levels it reached last week.
Overnight money was quoted 3.12/25 percent bid/ask, whereas it had changed hands at up to 3.31 percent on Friday.
The announcement this morning of a new Dutch Treasury Certificate maturing on July 31 and totalling 7.5 billion guilders did not have an effect on market rates, dealers said.
The July DTC was set at an indicative price of 3.14 percent in the afternoon, and the Finance Ministry's agent said there had already been activity in the new programme at that price.
The June DTC programme was also set at 3.14 percent, up from Friday's 3.13 percent. The December DTC was set at 3.20 percent.
The guilder traded at 112.490 per 100 marks, virtually unchanged from Friday.
